answer_1.quote: We designed a decoder to yield this multi-perspective inductive result... the decoder produces the answer word-by-word.
answer_1.outputs: multi-perspective inductive answers summarizing objective facts and subjective opinions

answer_2.quote: We further used BLEU (B n) and ROUGE (R n) to measure the generated quality of the inductive answer.

answer_4.quote: Moreover, we conducted human evaluations to qualitatively evaluate the answer's quality... we employed four metrics, including Factness (Fact) and Accuracy (Acc) to measure its objective part, Comprehensiveness (Comp) and Template Compliance (Tcp) for subjective part.
answer_4.guideline: Comprehensive guidelines were provided detailing the scoring criteria, scales, and examples.
